title: Kingston High School welcomed most students among Ulster County in 2024-25 school year
text:
Kingston High School had the highest enrollment among Ulster County schools, welcoming 1,747 students during the 2024-25 academic year, according to the New York State Education Department .
The most represented ethnicity among Kingston High School students was white, accounting for 48.8% of the student population.
Among the 40 schools in Ulster County, J. Watson Bailey Middle School ranked second in enrollment numbers with 936 students, while Wallkill Senior High School welcomed 930 students and came in third in the 2024-25 school year.
Kingston High School is part of Kingston City School District, which roughly covers 10 schools within Ulster County and has a main office in Kingston.
In the previous school year, Kingston High School also had the highest number of students among Ulster County schools.
According to an analysis by World Population Review, New York’s public education system ranked second overall in the nation but placed 31st based on K-12 performance.
